*Updated 2026-09-27 · 105 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

One hundred and five works. The September 27 rubble piece scores 2, closing the last twelve at 1, 1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 3, 2, 2 — median holds at 2, the hurricane barometer's 3 now sits four positions from the end, and nothing in the recent window has challenged it.

Camera position remains the most measurable stall. Straight-on accounts for 27 of 105 all-time, overhead 10, from-behind 10, low-angle 4. The last twelve offer one overhead and one from-behind, and the rest is frontal or unspecified. Every score of 4 in the archive came from displaced geometry. The barometer's 3 arrived through perceptual estrangement inside a conventional frame — the twin-needle tremor — and the rubble piece's hovering hand attempts something similar, but neither substitutes reliably for the geometric route, which has been functionally unused for most of the past two months. If the camera doesn't physically move, the ceiling stays at 3.

Scale violation sits at 29 of 105 all-time but only 4 of the last 12. Given that all four scores of 4 were scale-violation works, 33% is still underperforming. Figures continue their retreat: the last twelve show none or one in each frame, and the discipline on focal objects remains genuine — closed eye, abandoned shoe, fallen cylinder, tin can, barometer needle, bleached stump, hovering hand over rubble — no object has repeated inside that window, and that is one of the few active strengths.

Register compression is unchanged: aftermath and menace together account for 42 of 105 works. Encroachment appeared once and has not returned. Reckoning, reprieve, and betrayed defiance each appeared once. Foreboding appeared twice in the last twelve, which is a slight widening, but not yet a pattern. Exhaustion has two all-time appearances and has been dormant since Bangladesh. Title grammar has drifted: seven of the last twelve are miscellaneous constructions, and neither the X Without Y form nor the Wh- clause has consolidated into a signal.

The archive is disciplined and sustained, but discipline alone is producing a floor, not a ceiling. The camera has to move — low angle, overhead, through-frame, from-behind — and scale has to be violated not as a tactic but as the answer to a specific anchor, before the scores lift again.
